entries.description: Reviewed the representative Playwright suite, prerequisite handoff notes, and downstream Phase 2 session-set specs to confirm full-app-uat still inherits the stabilized workflow baseline.
Created docs/planning/full-app-uat-scope-ledger.md to freeze all five representative workflow IDs in their inherited order and preserve the narrow set of human-only checks that still add value.
Recorded the conservative queue scan verdict that no downstream Phase 2 session set is safe to overlap and that Session 2 work should stay inside the frozen workflow subset.

Defined findings classifications, severity and status buckets, remediation expectations, and final sign-off rules in the full-app UAT scope ledger, and updated the session spec to require the durable scope ledger outcome.

Ran dotnet build Dabbler.Platform.sln successfully with preview-SDK notices and one existing nullable warning; dotnet test Dabbler.Platform.sln passed on rerun after one transient Playwright E2E_WF_05 failure, with a focused E2E_WF_05 rerun passing and the final full solution test run passing 430/430.
Ran independent external session verification for Session 1 and saved the raw review output with verdict VERIFIED.

Verified the Session 1 prerequisites still exist, routed the Session 2 checklist design through ai-router as a documentation task, and created docs/session-sets/full-app-uat/full-app-uat-checklist.json with the frozen workflow order, automation guardrail boundaries, human-observation focus areas, defer rules, and structured issue-capture fields required for the full-app pass.

Added scripts/full-app-uat/Get-SessionInfo.ps1 and scripts/full-app-uat/Get-MagicLinks.ps1 as tiny loopback-only helpers over the existing guarded test-auth diagnostics so reviewers can confirm switched session scope or fetch the dev-captured magic link without adding new app-facing surfaces.

Facilitated the targeted full-app UAT pass by creating docs/session-sets/full-app-uat/reviewer-guide.md with launch, workflow-order, helper-usage, and issue-capture instructions so the later live browser review can stay inside the frozen subset without reopening scope.

Created docs/session-sets/full-app-uat/full-app-uat-findings.json as the durable findings ledger scaffold, separating pending checklist execution from confirmed defects, acceptable differences, and deferred follow-up while preserving the required deferred-owner field for Session 3 triage.

Ran dotnet build Dabbler.Platform.sln and dotnet test Dabbler.Platform.sln. An initial parallel launch caused transient MSBuild file-lock errors, so the validation pass was rerun sequentially after dotnet build-server shutdown; the sequential build succeeded cleanly, Playwright and the other test projects passed, and the remaining failure was the focused pre-existing web guardrail test AuthenticatedOrganizationSwitch_UpdatesShellAndAdminScopeAsync, which also failed on isolated rerun with an assertion that /admin/users did not contain the switched retail-organization name.

Ran independent external session verification for Session 2 against the new checklist, reviewer guide, findings ledger, helper scripts, activity log, git diff, and validation evidence. Saved the raw verifier output with verdict VERIFIED; the verifier noted only non-blocking observations and agreed the repeated web guardrail test failure is pre-existing and unrelated to the Session 2 artifacts.
